name: Russian CEE Kinetic and Sabotage Campaign
summary: Russian operations continue with extensive ballistic/drone strikes disabling 28 Ukrainian power stations, maritime drone strikes sinking merchant vessels in the Black Sea, and military satellite KOSMOS 2612 maneuvering aggressively against Finnish radar satellite ICEYE-X36.

name: Armory Castle Zero-Day Exploitation Cluster
summary: Chinese state-sponsored espionage group Armory Castle (formerly UNC5221) weaponizes BeyondTrust Remote Support zero-day CVE-2026-102764 for initial network access, under emergency CISA KEV directives.

name: ConnectWise Cloud Backup M365 Supply Chain Breach
summary: Threat actors abused compromised application identities (including GUID 506e08f9-6e9a-4da4-942b-a099a03644ae) within ConnectWise Cloud Backup to establish persistence and compromise 173 downstream Microsoft 365 customer tenants.

name: Commercial BMS and Cold-Chain Disruption Campaign
summary: Cyber-physical sabotage targeting internet-exposed Danfoss, Emerson Copeland, and Dixell BMS controllers across European retail networks; research confirms AI agents can reproduce Danfoss exploit chains in 28 minutes.

name: PEERSTITCH Fortinet Edge Exploitation Wave
summary: Threat actors (cluster CL-STA-0954) exploited FortiManager CVE-2024-47575 to exfiltrate configs and credentials from 500+ firewalls, deploying stealth in-memory ARM64 malware PEERSTITCH via FortiOS path traversal CVE-2025-61624.

name: AdFection Mercenary Spyware Campaign
summary: Mercenary surveillance ecosystem deploying zero-click exploits (Candiru/Pegasus) against European and Balkan targets, recently confirmed against Serbian anti-corruption figures and journalists.

name: GhostAction CI/CD Credential Exfiltration Wave
summary: Supply chain compromise spanning 94+ GitHub repositories, using malicious workflows and weaponized developer font files to deliver infostealers and siphon cloud/CI credentials.

name: ROMULUS ClickFix Malware Delivery Cluster
summary: Malware delivery service deploying ClickFix lures via compromised landing pages and custom GPTs to execute PowerShell staging commands and deliver Legion Loader disguised with repetitive archive padding.

name: Rank Math PRO Supply Chain Tampering
summary: Compromise of the official Rank Math distribution portal delivering trojanized version 3.0.123 packages containing a self-restoring PHP backdoor.

name: ShinyHunters Collusive Extortion Network
summary: Extortion campaign responsible for breaches of fbijobs.gov and corporate targets, operating in collusive coordination with compromised cyber incident response negotiators.

name: Plex2Shell Opportunistic Weaponization Wave
summary: Automated exploitation of a chained four-vulnerability sequence in Plex Media Server within hours of PoC release, deploying crypto-miners and reverse proxies.

name: AOMEI Backupper Update Server Tampering Campaign
summary: Threat actors repeatedly compromised AOMEI's official update servers in 5-to-10-minute bursts to deliver trojanized application updates that deployed secondary backdoors onto target Windows endpoints.

name: n0n Maritime and Logistics Extortion Wave
summary: Financially motivated extortion collective posting exfiltrated operational EDI feeds, manifests, and system configurations from 38 port and shipping entities across 18 countries via a compromised shared logistics application.

name: YAM Store Phishing and Impersonation Ecosystem
summary: Massive Chinese-language cybercrime syndicates (YAM Store, CoGUI, Iron Man) generating over 1 billion phishing messages across 150 countries, recently targeted by joint Microsoft and Health-ISAC domain seizures.

name: MALFEX Supply Chain Infiltration Campaign
summary: Adversaries deploying malicious open-source packages (such as 'imgdecode') to the public npm registry containing native compiled Windows C++ addons to inject in-memory shellcode loaders into developer endpoints.
